response.sql:
SELECT t.tradekind, COUNT(*) AS analysis_count, COUNT(*)::numeric / SUM(COUNT(*)) OVER () AS share_of_analyses
FROM advancedbehavior AS a
JOIN transactionrecord AS tr ON tr.transreg = a.translink
JOIN trader AS t ON t.tradereg = tr.trdref
GROUP BY t.tradekind;

assumptions.assumption: The denominator is the total number of qualifying analysis records across all trader types; each advancedbehavior row counts once, including multiple analyses linked to the same transaction.
